olivia: Heads up 10: client SoteriaHealth wants to run a 2-week POC for structured discharge summaries using our streaming SDK + function calls. They want the model to emit a strict JSON schema which our backend will validate before storing. Need quick runbook, cost band for ~2k concurrent streams, and security questionnaire answers (esp. around PHI).

ben: Great. Are they using browser clients or an edge aggregator?

olivia: Browser clients in hospitals connecting through an on-prem proxy that will perform SAML auth and token issuance. The proxy will also be the only component allowed to send identifiable data upstream; they want an architecture diagram for security.

hassan: For 2k streams Dedicated should be fine; pricing ballpark $6k-$9k/mo depending on token rates and whether caching reduces costs. Private option obviously higher. I'll draft the estimate.

emma: For schema validation, suggest this flow: model -> validate against JSON Schema server-side -> if valid, execute tool (EMR lookup) -> if invalid, instruct model to reformat with clarifying prompt. Add failure thresholds.

olivia: Can we provide a sample schema in the thread? Also include a sample JS SDK streaming snippet and the handshake for ephemeral creds.

notice: [system] Added checklist: 'SoteriaHealth POC - security packet requested' by olivia at 1745558888

ben: Sample JS snippet (short): `const s = client.stream({model:'redwood-stream-1', session:'soteria-poc'}); s.on('data', d => validateAndRoute(d));`

hassan: Quick note on function/tool calls: recommend in-band func JSON and strictly typed schema. We'll need to set a token limit on returned records and rate-limit lookups. Also recommend caching recent lookups to reduce calls.

emma: Security wants: KMS, IP allowlist, audit logs, and confirmation that logs won't contain PHI. We'll recommend redaction at proxy and storing only tokenized IDs in hosted logs.

olivia: Also include a small troubleshooting section: reconnect handling, backpressure signals from server, and how to resume sessions using our resume token.

ben: Drive links: runbook template: https://drive.redwood.example/runbook-template, pricing calc: https://drive.redwood.example/soteria-pricing.

hassan: I'll add expected latencies for in-band calls (avg 120-200ms depending on region) and note that colocating proxy and inference reduces RTT.

olivia: Action items: Ben -> SDK snippets + runbook draft; Emma -> validation flow + failure policy; Hassan -> pricing + latency numbers; I'll assemble packet and send to Soteria security.

emma: Also flag: if customer insists on guaranteed PHI isolation, recommend Private with BAA.

olivia: Thanks all. I'll follow up with a calendar invite for the POC kickoff. :raised_hands:
